notes: Read all three units, full working-family context, all ten candidates and the review. Restored collaboration with business, labor and other stakeholders to the profit-sharing incentive while retaining that it supplements wages and raises and targets workers and businesses needing it most. Also restored the opening requirement that work-family policy help caregivers and the purpose of meeting family needs through a stable paid-caregiving workforce.

claims.claim_text: Work and family policies must help family caregivers.
A strong, stable paid-caregiving workforce should be created to meet families' needs through higher wages, better training access and opportunities for workers' collective voice.

Working with business, labor and other stakeholders, Democrats would incentivize companies to share profits with employees in addition to wages and raises while targeting workers and businesses needing profit-sharing most.
